steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing. Wait 3 minutes after unplugging before measuring SMPS terminals (160 Vdc may remain). R-134a sealed-system precautions apply.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: No water or ice dispense?
steps.body: Select water/cube/crushed at dispenser — pressing rubber button opens solenoids. Stops when freezer door open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Select water/cube/crushed at dispenser — pressing rubber button opens solenoids. Stops when freezer door open.

steps.title: Water valve and relays
steps.body: Verify water solenoid on back plate and relay RY7 (water), RY4/RY5/RY12 (ice) per §2-18 and troubleshooting.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify water solenoid on back plate and relay RY7 (water), RY4/RY5/RY12 (ice) per §2-18 and troubleshooting.

steps.title: Replace valve or relay
steps.oemOutcome: Replace water inlet valve, duct door solenoid, or dispenser relays.
